description: Keeps the parameters of several instances of the same module in step, so a change to one of them changes all of them.

inputs.text: Drives one parameter of the mirrored modules with 0-10V; which parameter this port reaches is assigned on its context menu.

notes: once bound, the mirrored modules can be moved anywhere in the patch.
nothing is mirrored until Bind source module (left) has taken a module's parameters and Map module (right) has linked a second instance of the same model.
menu: Bind source module (left) — takes every parameter of the module on the left, Map module (right) links the module on the other side to it, and Add and map new module adds one and links it.
Sync module presets — copies the source module's whole preset to the mirrored modules, which covers internal state that parameters do not reach; Shift and S does the same.
CV inputs — assigns each of the eight input ports to one parameter of the bound modules, or to None.
Audio rate processing — switched on, the mirrored parameters are updated every sample instead of every 32nd sample.
Hide mapping indicators — stops the square being drawn beside each mirrored parameter.
